title: Pause all AGVs and resume all AGVs using Aveva API Geek+ RMS commands
summary: Use the Aveva API interface that exposes selected Geek+ RMS commands to temporarily pause all AGVs and then resume them. The source states the Aveva API includes “Pause all AGVs” and “Resume all AGVs” commands.
when_to_use: When you need to temporarily pause all AGVs and then bring them back to resumed operation using the Aveva API command set that mirrors selected Geek+ RMS commands (specifically “Pause all AGVs” and “Resume all AGVs”).
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the Aveva API commands to pause all AGVs and then resume all AGVs, and verify the resulting paused/resumed state using the Aveva API page’s command result/status feedback.
safety_notes: If the action is part of a restart procedure, follow the source safety note to E-stop before restart.
